name: NetBird Community Edition Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free ongoing self-hosted WireGuard mesh networking with control plane, peer connectivity, policies and routing; no Community Edition license fee or time limit.
watch_out: Requires self-managed management/signal/relay servers and identity/network configuration. Server components use AGPLv3 and clients BSD-3-Clause; active-active HA, SCIM, peer approval and some enterprise logging require a paid commercial license. Distinct from NetBird Cloud Free.
